versions.content: Service Name EthIf_EthMacSecUpdateSecYNotification (draft) Syntax void EthIf_EthMacSecUpdateSecYNotification ( uint8 PhysCtrlIdx, uint8 Result ) Service ID [hex] 0x9e Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Reentrant for different PhysCtrlIdx, Non reentrant for the same PhysCtrlIdx Parameters (in) PhysCtrlIdx Index of the physical Ethernet controller within the context of Ethernet Interface ▽ △ Result E_OK : Ethernet controller updated SecY with the provided parameters in a previous call of Eth_MacSecUpdateSecY E_NOT_OK : Ethernet controller failed to updated SecY with the provided parameters in a previous call of Eth_MacSecUpdateSec Y Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Callback to notify that the Ethernet controller has finished attempts to update SecY with provided parameters in a previous call of Eth_MacSecUpdateSecY. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via EthIf.h
